data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, the name Anithya means 'immutable' or 'everlasting'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anitya', which means 'transient' or 'impermanent'. The name embodies the idea of something that never changes, is eternal, and unending. The name Anithya carries the meaning “Immutable, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anithya usually hope their child will grow to embody immutable, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anithya carries a profound cultural significance in Hinduism as it is believed to represent the eternal nature of the soul. In Hinduism, it is believed that the soul is eternal and does not die with the body. The name Anithya serves as a reminder of this belief and the idea of the soul's immortality.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Anithya holds a deep spiritual significance as it symbolizes nothingness or the absence of maya (illusion) in Hindu philosophy. It reminds us of the impermanence of material existence and the importance of liberating the soul from the cycle of birth and death. The name encourages us to turn inward and seek the eternal and unchanging truth, ultimately leading us towards self-realization and enlightenment.
